question: Evaluate: 7 - [5 + 1/3 / {2/3 of 9/4 + (1/2 - 1/6)}]
solution:
**Given:**

7 - [5 + 1/3 / {2/3 of 9/4 + (1/2 - 1/6)}]

**Formula Used:**

Division and multiplication rules: a / b = a ÷ b; a × b = a × b

Order of operations: Brackets → Of → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction

**Calculation:**

7 - [5 + 1/3 / {2/3 of 9/4 + (1/2 - 1/6)}]

⇒ 7 - [5 + 1/3 / {2/3 × 9/4 + ((3 - 1)/6 )}
